newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end lower, nervous ahead of U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end lower, nervous ahead of U.S. data.

text.p: Tokyo stocks tumbled by the end of the Friday session, following a sharp slide on Wall Street overnight.
Brokers said that the Tokyo market was bracing for the U.S. August employment report to be released later today.
The key 225-share Nikkei average closed down 227.29 points or 1.12 percent at 20,152.53. Its September futures shed 160 points to end at 20,250.
"The bottom of the Nikkei is being supported at 20,000, but I'm not sure if it will be after the U.S. employment data," said Hiroshi Morimoto, general manager at Daiwa Securities Co Ltd.
